```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(cowplot)   # ggdraw, draw_image, plot_grid
library(ggplot2)
fig_dir <- params$fig_dir
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir))
  stop("Figure folder not found: '", normalizePath(fig_dir, mustWork = FALSE),
       "'. Set params$fig_dir or run reports/stage_figures.sh (see reports/README.md).", call. = FALSE)
```

# How this document is organized

This report shows **p-value histogram**, **QQ plot**, **volcano**, and a **forest plot** for each exposure, grouped by:
- **Level:** gene vs transcript, and
- **Source:** maternal blood PFAS (*mat*) vs fetal/child blood PFAS (*child*).

Each panel is a 2 × 2 grid in this order: histogram, QQ, volcano, forest.

```{r helpers}
# Helper to draw a 2x2 panel for a given prefix ('gene' or 'tx') and condition like 'PFBS_child'/'PFOA_mat'
render_panel <- function(prefix = c("gene","tx"), cond) {
  prefix <- match.arg(prefix)

  # File names expected
  files <- lapply(list(
    pvals  = sprintf("%s_diffPOE_%s_BetaInt_pvals.png", prefix, cond),
    pqq    = sprintf("%s_diffPOE_%s_BetaInt_pQQ.png",   prefix, cond),
    main   = sprintf("%s_diffPOE_%s_BetaInt.png",       prefix, cond),
    forest = sprintf("%s_forest_%s.png",                prefix, cond)
  ), function(f) file.path(fig_dir, f))

  # Check existence and report any missing (still attempt to draw what's available)
  missing <- names(files)[!file.exists(unlist(files))]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("[WARN] Missing for %s/%s: %s", prefix, cond, paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  # Build placeholders for missing images to keep layout stable
  make_img <- function(path) {
    if (file.exists(path)) {
      ggdraw() + draw_image(path, scale = 1)
    } else {
      ggdraw() + draw_label(sprintf("Missing: %s", basename(path)), size = 12)
    }
  }

  p1 <- make_img(files$pvals)
  p2 <- make_img(files$pqq)
  p3 <- make_img(files$main)
  p4 <- make_img(files$forest)

  plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
}

conds_child <- c("PFBA_child","PFOA_child","PFNA_child","PFDA_child","PFUnDA_child","PFBS_child","PFHxS_child","PFOS_child")
conds_mat   <- c("PFBA_mat","PFOA_mat","PFNA_mat","PFDA_mat","PFUnDA_mat","PFBS_mat","PFHxS_mat","PFOS_mat")
```

# Gene-level — Child PFAS

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=10, fig.align='center', results='asis'}
for (cond in conds_child) {
  cat(sprintf("## %s

", cond))
  print(render_panel(prefix = "gene", cond = cond))
  cat("

")
}
```
